origin.description: Download one remote, record its metadata, and install it.
origin.usage: install_remote(remote, dependencies, upgrade, force, quiet, build, build_opts, build_manual, build_vignettes, repos, type, ...)

arguments.name: remote
arguments.text: One remote object, such as the value of local_remote.

arguments.name: dependencies
arguments.text: Passed to the dependency installer. FALSE installs none.

arguments.name: force
arguments.text: When TRUE, install even if the recorded sha matches the installed package.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

origin.details: A cran remote is installed with install.packages. Every other remote is downloaded, given metadata, and installed with R CMD INSTALL. A download error returns NULL when it is caught.
origin.example: install_remote(remotes:::local_remote(pkg), dependencies = FALSE, upgrade = "never", quiet = TRUE, build = FALSE, lib = lib)

translation.description: Download one remote, record its metadata, and install it.
translation.usage: install_remote(remote, dependencies=NA, upgrade='default', force=False, quiet=False, build=True, lib=None)

arguments.name: remote
arguments.text: A remote object. Importing this module registers the install methods.
Further arguments are passed to install.packages. lib is the library directory and is accepted.

translation.details: The bundle is downloaded with urllib and installed with R CMD INSTALL into lib. A check uses a fresh temporary library and does not write to ~/R/library. A cran remote is installed with Rscript utils::install.packages.
translation.example: install_remote(local_remote(pkg), dependencies=False, upgrade="never", quiet=True, build=False, lib=lib)
